title: Brain2 C++ Parameter Sweep — global_gain × tau_decay

summary.sweet_spot: gain=0.001, tau_decay=100ms (CV=43.5%, differentiated torque, food-approach behavior)
key_observations: tau_decay=100ms dominates the top 3 positions — optimal time constant for biological differentiation
At gain ≥ 0.005, torque saturation kills differentiation regardless of decay (CV drops to 1-17%)
At gain=0.01, only one combination exceeds CV=10% (decay=100ms at 17.38%)
Food distance decreases in 13/20 combinations (approach behavior)
MN activation oscillates between discrete states: 0, 429, 517, 589
All 36 joints activate at gain ≤ 0.002; joint count drops at high gain (saturation)
Engine C++ with 139K neurons shows stable convergence within 15s at all parameter values
47.46% CV appears as a recurring ceiling — likely the engine's intrinsic torque topology limit
summary.phase_12_2_recommendation: Start RL with gain=0.001, decay=100ms. Explore gain ∈ [0.00075, 0.0015] and decay ∈ [80, 120] around the sweet spot. Use CV as the primary reward signal.
